prompts.text: Take this drawing created by my child (the uploaded image) and turn it into a photorealistic image or realistic 3D render. It is supposed to be an animal or a creature (a lion, an elephant, a dinosaur, a dragon, a monster, a bird, a fish or a bug). Keep the original shape, proportions, line lengths, and all imperfections exactly as they are in the drawing, including any uneven lines or strange markings. Do not correct, smooth out or change any details of its design. Make it look like this thing exists in the real world, with realistic textures (fur, feathers etc) and natural lighting. You can add realistic shadows and an environment or background that fits the feel of the drawing, but don't change anything about the form or the details of what they created. No pencil, crayon textures or hand drawn styles: this must look like a photo or CGI render, but staying true to their imagination. Keep the same number of legs, wheels, eyes, ears, horns, wings and tails, the same colors in the same places, and the same face and expression. Never correct the drawing into a normal one: if the drawing has a huge round mane on four thin stick legs, the real one has exactly that. The place: a real place that fits it, a lion or an elephant on a sunny savanna, a dinosaur or a monster in a green valley, a bird on a branch, a fish in clear water. Warm golden-hour sunlight, a real shadow on the ground, real eyes with catchlights, shot on a full-frame camera at the creature's eye level. The whole creature in frame, from the top of its head to its feet, in the lower two thirds of the picture, facing the camera or three-quarters to it. At the top center of the frame, a small rectangular inset shows the uploaded drawing itself, exactly as in the uploaded image, about one quarter of the frame width, with a thin white border. If the drawing also shows a person, that person becomes a soft plush toy figure of the same shape and colors with stitched button eyes, never a real human. Vertical 9:16. No people, no human faces, no hands, no children anywhere in the picture. No text other than what is on the drawing in the inset, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.text: The real creature from the drawing comes alive in its real place, one continuous shot on film. It keeps exactly the shape, proportions, colors and face of the image in every frame: never more normal, never taller or thinner, no extra legs, no new parts. It blinks, looks around with curiosity, then takes a few steps toward the camera on its own legs in the way its body allows (a bird flaps, a fish swims), its fur or feathers move in the breeze, and it ends with a small happy roar or call. The camera slowly pushes in at its eye level. Warm sunlight, grass and leaves move gently in the wind. Audio: the natural sounds of the place and the creature's own small roar or call, no music. The small drawing inset at the top center stays exactly the same and in the same place for the whole clip. No people, no human faces, no hands, no text, no logos, no watermark.
